notes: This page is a picture, not a list: pick AUTO (Case Auto) or M (Case Manual) on the left, then adjust the settings shown for it. Row numbers here follow the manual's callouts.
Only this management page exists until you add your own My Menu tabs. Each tab you add becomes another page here.

image-quality.desc: File type and size for stills: RAW, C-RAW, JPEG/HEIF and their sizes, or RAW+JPEG.

dual-pixel-raw.desc: Records extra Dual Pixel data in RAW files so you can fine-tune them in Canon software later. Files get much bigger.

stills-cropping-aspect-ratio.desc: Shoot full-frame, 1.6x crop (APS-C), or with a 1:1, 4:3 or 16:9 aspect ratio.

digital-tele-conv.desc: Digital teleconverter: in-camera digital zoom for stills (crops and enlarges the center of the frame).

expo-comp-aeb.desc: Exposure compensation plus auto exposure bracketing (AEB) for stills.

stills-iso-speed-settings.desc: ISO for stills: the manual ISO range, the Auto ISO range, and the minimum shutter speed Auto ISO will allow.

anti-flicker-shoot.desc: Detects flickering lights (e.g. fluorescent) and times each shot to the brightest moment so exposure and color stay even.

hf-anti-flicker-shooting.desc: High-frequency anti-flicker: finds a shutter speed that avoids banding from fast-flickering LED lights.

external-speedlite-control.desc: Settings for a flash on the hot shoe: firing, E-TTL metering, flash exposure compensation, sync and the flash's own custom functions.

metering-mode.desc: How the camera measures light: evaluative, partial, spot or center-weighted average.

detect-priority-ae-while-af.desc: Weights exposure toward the subject the AF has detected (face, animal, vehicle).

color-mode.desc: Picture Style (Standard, Portrait, Landscape, Monochrome...) or Custom Picture / Canon Log, plus sharpness, contrast, saturation and tone tweaks.

color-space.desc: Color space for stills: sRGB or Adobe RGB.

clarity.desc: Adds or reduces mid-tone edge contrast (like a clarity slider in editing software).

hdr-shooting-pq.desc: Records HDR stills/movies with the PQ curve (HEIF for stills) for viewing on HDR screens.

hdr-mode.desc: In-camera HDR stills: merges several exposures into one image with more dynamic range.

auto-lighting-optimizer.desc: Automatically lifts shadows and corrects contrast in JPEG/HEIF images. Off, Low, Standard or High.

highlight-tone-priority.desc: Protects highlight detail (raises the minimum ISO). Enable or Enhanced.

white-balance-setting.desc: White balance presets, Kelvin, custom WB, WB correction/bracketing and how quickly Auto WB reacts.

lens-aberration-correction.desc: Lens corrections: vignetting, distortion, chromatic aberration, diffraction, Digital Lens Optimizer and focus-breathing correction.

long-exp-noise-reduction.desc: Dark-frame noise reduction for exposures of 1 second or longer. Doubles the wait after each long shot.

high-iso-speed-nr.desc: Noise reduction strength for high-ISO JPEG/HEIF images (and movies).

dust-delete-data.desc: Captures a reference of sensor dust so Canon software can erase the spots from images later.

multiple-exposure.desc: Blends several shots into one image (additive, average, bright or dark).

focus-bracketing.desc: Shoots a burst while stepping focus, for focus stacking. Can also merge the frames in camera (depth composite).

drive-mode.desc: Single shot, high-speed/low-speed continuous (burst) or self-timer.

pre-cont-shooting.desc: Pre-continuous (pre-capture): buffers frames while you half-press, so the burst starts slightly before you fully press.

interval-timer.desc: Intervalometer: takes a set number of stills at a fixed interval.

bulb-timer.desc: Sets a fixed bulb exposure time (e.g. 2 minutes) so you don't need to hold the shutter button.

silent-shutter-function.desc: Silent shooting: uses the electronic shutter and turns off sounds.

shutter-mode.desc: Mechanical, electronic first-curtain or fully electronic shutter.

release-shutter-without-card.desc: Whether the camera can take a picture with no card inserted. Disable it so you never shoot without a card.

is-image-stabilizer-mode.desc: In-body/lens image stabilization settings, including Digital IS and Movie IS, and the focal length for non-communicating lenses.

metering-timer.desc: How long exposure info stays active after you release the shutter button.

image-review.desc: Shows the picture right after you take it, and for how long (off, 2 s, 4 s, 8 s, hold).

high-speed-display.desc: Shows the live view between frames during high-speed continuous shooting.

display-simulation.desc: Whether the screen/EVF previews exposure and depth of field (WYSIWYG).

ovf-sim-view-assist.desc: OVF simulation: shows a wider-tone, optical-viewfinder-like view in high-contrast scenes.

stills-movie-play-hdr-c-log-view-assist.desc: View assist: shows a normal-looking image on the screen while shooting HDR PQ or Canon Log.

shooting-info-disp.desc: What the screen and EVF show: info screens, grid, histogram, waveform, electronic level size, card space, aspect markers.
shooting-info-disp.fw: Firmware 1.1.0 lets you set the grid display during movie recording too.

stills-quick-control-customization.desc: Choose and arrange the items on the Q (Quick Control) screen for stills.

display-frame-rate-set.desc: Refresh rate of the screen/EVF: Smooth (higher frame rate) or the power-saving default.

vf-display-format.desc: Choose how shooting info is laid out in the viewfinder.

reverse-display.desc: Mirrored (selfie) view when the screen faces forward.

auto-pwr-off-temp.desc: How hot the camera may get during recording before it shuts down: Standard or High.

movie-rec-size.desc: Movie resolution and frame rate (e.g. 4K, Full HD, 60p, 120p) and compression.

movie-rec-format.desc: Movie file format and codec: RAW, XF-HEVC S or XF-AVC S, 8-bit or 10-bit, 4:2:0 or 4:2:2. Also proxy and sub-movie recording.

sound-recording.desc: Turns movie audio recording on or off.

audio-format.desc: Movie audio format: AAC or LPCM, 16/24-bit, 2 or 4 channels.

audio-settings.desc: Input (built-in, external mic, hot shoe), recording level, wind filter and attenuator.

audio-status.desc: Audio meters and which channels you hear while monitoring.

movie-iso-speed-settings.desc: ISO for movies, including the maximum ISO Auto may use.

movie-auto-slow-shutter.desc: Lets the camera drop to a slower shutter speed in low light during movie recording.

movie-auto-level.desc: Keeps movies level (corrects camera tilt) during recording.

shooting-mode.desc: Picks the scene or special movie mode used when the Mode dial is set to SCN (or the special movie position).

open-gate.desc: Records movies from the full sensor area (3:2) for reframing to vertical or other aspect ratios later.

movie-cropping.desc: Records movies with a cropped (APS-C sized) area of the sensor.

movie-av-1-8-stop-incr.desc: Changes aperture in finer 1/8-stop steps for smoother changes while recording.

hdr-movie-mode.desc: In-camera HDR movie recording for high-contrast scenes.

pre-recording-set.desc: Pre-recording: continuously buffers a few seconds so the movie starts before you press record.

time-lapse-movie.desc: Shoots stills at intervals and makes them into a time-lapse movie in camera.

movie-self-timer.desc: Self-timer delay before movie recording starts.

tally-lamp.desc: Front tally lamp that lights while recording.

mag-rec-display.desc: Shows a magnified view while recording (useful for focus checks).

metadata.desc: Adds news/XML metadata to movie files.

time-code.desc: Time code for movies: count up, start time, drop frame, HDMI output and user bit.

false-color-set.desc: False color exposure display for movies.

zebra-settings.desc: Zebra stripes that show over- or correctly-exposed areas, with adjustable levels.

quick-ctrl-screen.desc: Which Quick Control screen style appears in movie mode.

movie-quick-control-customization-q1.desc: Choose and arrange items on the movie Q (Quick Control) screen.

standby-low-res.desc: Lowers live view resolution while not recording to save power and heat.

shutdown-warning-guidance.desc: Shows a warning when the camera is about to shut down from heat.

hdmi-display.desc: What the HDMI output shows: clean output or with info, and whether the camera screen stays on.

hdmi-raw-output.desc: Sends RAW video over HDMI to an external recorder (e.g. ProRes RAW).

hdmi-output-range-for-c-log.desc: HDMI signal range (full or narrow) when outputting Canon Log.

af-operation.desc: One-Shot AF (locks focus) or Servo AF (tracks moving subjects).

af-area.desc: AF area: Spot, 1-point, Expand AF area, Flexible Zone 1-3 or Whole area AF.

whole-area-tracking-servo-af.desc: In Servo AF, lets tracking follow the subject anywhere in the frame, starting from your chosen AF area.

focus-mode.desc: AF or MF, shown when the lens has no AF/MF switch.

subject-to-detect.desc: What AF looks for: People, Animals, Vehicles, Auto or None.

eye-detection.desc: Eye AF: Auto, right eye, left eye or off.

register-people-priority.desc: Register faces so AF prioritizes those people.

case-auto.desc: Case Auto: the camera adjusts Servo AF tracking behavior automatically.

case-auto-character.desc: Bias for Case Auto: Locked on vs. Responsive.

case-manual.desc: Case Manual: set Servo AF tracking parameters yourself.

tracking-sensitivity.desc: How readily Servo AF switches to obstacles vs. stays on the subject.

accel-decel-tracking.desc: How Servo AF handles subjects that suddenly speed up, stop or change direction.

servo-1st-image-priority.desc: First shot in Servo AF: release priority (shoot now) or focus priority.

one-shot-af-release-prior.desc: In One-Shot AF, whether the shutter can fire before focus is confirmed.

preview-af.desc: Keeps focusing continuously even before you half-press (faster AF, more battery use).

lens-drive-when-af-impossible.desc: Whether the lens keeps hunting (focus search) when it can't find focus.

af-assist-beam-firing.desc: Turns the AF-assist light on or off.

limit-af-areas.desc: Hide AF area modes you don't use so switching is quicker.

orientation-linked-af-point.desc: Separate AF points/areas for horizontal and vertical holds.

limit-subject-to-detect.desc: Hide subject types you don't use so switching is quicker.

l-r-eye-detection.desc: Hide Eye detection options (Auto / Right eye / Left eye) you don't use, so switching between them is quicker.

mf-peaking-settings.desc: Focus peaking: on/off, level and color.

focus-guide.desc: On-screen guide showing which way to turn the focus ring and when focus is reached.

lens-electronic-mf.desc: Full-time manual focus with the focus ring after or during AF.

half-button-clear-mf-magnify.desc: Half-pressing the shutter button exits the magnified manual-focus view.

register-recall-af-related-settings.desc: Save a set of AF settings and recall them quickly.

subject-switching-sensitivity.desc: How readily movie AF switches between subjects.

af-for-close-up-demos.desc: Movie AF that prioritizes objects held up to the camera (product reviews, demos).
af-for-close-up-demos.fw: Firmware 1.1.0 makes this available in Creative Zone movie modes, not only the dedicated scene mode.

movie-servo-af-speed.desc: How fast focus moves in movie AF, and when the speed setting applies.

track-after-focusing.desc: Keeps tracking the subject after you focus manually.

erase-images.desc: Delete selected images, a range, or all images in a folder/card.

rotate-stills.desc: Rotate a still image during playback.

change-mov-rotate-info.desc: Change the rotation info stored in a movie file.

protect-when-setting-the-rating.desc: Automatically protects an image when you rate it.

stills-image-copy.desc: Copy images from one card to the other.

raw-image-processing.desc: Convert RAW images to JPEG/HEIF in camera with adjustable settings.

creative-assist.desc: Apply quick looks and adjustments to RAW images in playback.

quick-control-raw-processing.desc: Quick Control-style RAW processing in playback.

resize.desc: Save a smaller copy of a JPEG/HEIF image.

cropping.desc: Crop a JPEG/HEIF image in camera and save a copy.

slide-show.desc: Play images as a slide show.

set-image-search-conditions.desc: Filter playback by rating, date, folder, protection or file type.

view-from-last-seen.desc: Playback starts at the last image you viewed instead of the newest.

magnification.desc: Initial zoom level and position when magnifying in playback.

playback-information-display.desc: Choose which info screens (histogram, shooting data...) appear in playback.

af-point-disp.desc: Shows the AF point(s) used on images in playback.

movie-play-count.desc: Shows recording time or time code during movie playback.

connect-to-smartphone-tablet.desc: Pair with a phone (Camera Connect app) via Bluetooth/Wi-Fi: remote shooting, image transfer, auto send.

connect-to-wireless-remote.fw: Firmware 1.1.0 adds support for the BR-E2 wireless remote.

connect-to-eos-utility.desc: Wireless connection to EOS Utility on a computer (tethering, transfer).

upload-to-image-canon.desc: Auto-upload to Canon's image.canon cloud service (also used for firmware updates over Wi-Fi).

transfer-images-to-ftp-server.desc: Send images to an FTP/SFTP/FTPS server.

advanced-connection.desc: Detailed connection setup, including Camera Control API (CCAPI).
advanced-connection.fw: Firmware 1.1.0 adds support for the EDSDK/CCAPI developer kits.

usb-uvc-uac-streaming.desc: Use the camera as a USB webcam (UVC/UAC), with power over USB.

hdmi-streaming.desc: Settings for live streaming over HDMI.

airplane-mode.desc: Turns off all wireless (Wi-Fi and Bluetooth).

wi-fi-settings.desc: Wi-Fi on/off, band (2.4/5 GHz), channels and saved networks.

camera-name.desc: Camera nickname shown on Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

error-details.desc: Details of the last network/communication error.

gps-device-settings.desc: Geotagging from a GPS receiver (GP-E2) or your phone.

choose-usb-connection-app.desc: What the camera does on a USB connection: photo import/remote control or webcam streaming.

save-load-comm-settings-on-card.desc: Back up or restore network settings using the card.

reset-communication-settings.desc: Clears all network and pairing settings.

record-func-card-folder-sel.desc: Dual card behavior (standard, auto switch, record separately, record to both/backup, relay), card for playback, and folders.

stills-file-numbering.desc: Still file numbering: continuous, auto reset or manual reset.

movie-clip-number.desc: Movie clip numbering: continuous or auto reset.

file-name.desc: Set the file name prefix for stills and naming for movies.

format-card.desc: Format (erase everything on) a memory card, with optional low-level format.

auto-rotate.desc: Rotates vertical images automatically for display on the camera and/or computer.

add-movie-rotate-info.desc: Records orientation info in movies so vertical clips play upright.

date-time-zone.desc: Set date, time, time zone and daylight saving.

system-frequency.desc: NTSC (59.94 Hz) or PAL (50 Hz) movie frame rates.

help-text-size.desc: Size of the help text shown with the INFO button.

feature-guide.desc: Short descriptions that pop up when selecting modes and functions.

beep.desc: Turns the focus-confirm and touch beeps on or off.

volume.desc: Volume of camera sounds, including the electronic shutter sound.

audio-monitor.desc: Headphone volume and monitoring channels (headphones and HDMI).

screen-viewfinder-color-tone.desc: Color tone of the screen and viewfinder (warmer or cooler).

fine-tune-vf-color-tone.desc: Fine adjustment of the viewfinder's color tone.

screen-viewfinder-display.desc: Switch between screen and EVF automatically, or force only screen/only viewfinder.

ui-magnification.desc: Pinch/double-tap to magnify menus for easier reading.

hdmi-resolution.desc: HDMI output resolution for playback on a TV.

shutter-at-shutdown.desc: Close the shutter curtain when the camera powers off to protect the sensor from dust.

sensor-cleaning.desc: Clean the sensor now, automatic cleaning at power on/off, or lock up for manual cleaning.

manage-password.desc: Password request at power-on/wake, change the password, or clear entered info.

power-saving.desc: Timers for screen dimming, screen off, viewfinder off and auto power off.

reset-camera.desc: Reset individual settings or do a full factory reset.

custom-shooting-mode-c1-c3.desc: Save the current settings to the C1, C2 or C3 positions on the mode dial.

save-load-cam-settings-on-card.desc: Save all camera settings to a card, or load them back.

battery-info.desc: Battery level, shots taken, and recharge/health status.

copyright-information.desc: Embed author and copyright info in every image.

show-log.desc: Shows a log of changes to the password, network info and other settings.

manual-software-url.desc: QR code linking to manuals and software.

firmware.desc: Shows the current firmware version and updates the firmware.

customize-buttons-for-shooting.desc: Assign functions to buttons for shooting (e.g. back-button AF on AF-ON, AE lock, M-Fn).

shutter-btn-function-for-movies.desc: What half- and full-pressing the shutter button does in movie mode.

customize-dials-control-ring.desc: Assign functions to the dials and the lens control ring.

main-qcd2-qcd1-direction-to-set-tv-av.desc: Reverse the direction of the dials when setting shutter speed/aperture.

ring-direction-to-set-tv-av.desc: Reverse the lens control ring direction when setting shutter speed/aperture.

switch-main-qcd2-when-shooting.desc: Swap the functions of the Main dial and Quick control dial 2 when shooting.

touch-shutter.desc: Tap the screen to focus and shoot.

multi-function-lock.desc: Choose which controls the LOCK switch locks.

touch-drag-af-settings.desc: Move the AF point by dragging on the screen while using the viewfinder.

af-area-selection-control.desc: After pressing the AF point selection button, which control switches the AF area: the M-Fn button or the Main dial.

mc-sensitivity-af-pt-select.desc: How fast the multi-controller moves the AF point.

focus-control-ring.desc: Switch an RF lens's focus/control ring between focus and control-ring functions.

rf-lens-mf-focus-ring-sensitivity.desc: Focus ring response: varies with rotation speed, or linear (linked to rotation angle).

customize-buttons-for-playback.desc: Assign functions to buttons during playback.

image-jump-w-main.desc: How many images the Main dial jumps in playback (1, 10, 100, by date, rating...).

img-jump-w-assign-qcd1.desc: Image jump method when holding an assigned button and turning Quick control dial 1.

switch-main-qcd2-during-playback.desc: Swap the Main dial and Quick control dial 2 functions in playback.

touch-control.desc: Touchscreen sensitivity, or turn touch off.

exposure-level-increments.desc: Shutter, aperture and exposure compensation steps: 1/3 or 1/2 stop.

speed-from-metering-iso-auto.desc: With Auto ISO, whether ISO returns to Auto after metering ends or keeps the value used.

bracketing-auto-cancel.desc: Whether bracketing turns off when you power off the camera.

number-of-bracketed-shots.desc: How many shots per bracket: 2, 3, 5 or 7.

safety-shift.desc: Lets the camera shift shutter speed/aperture or ISO when your setting would give a bad exposure.

same-expo-for-new-aperture.desc: Keeps exposure the same when the max aperture changes (zoom lenses, extenders) by adjusting ISO or shutter.

ae-lock-meter-mode-after-focus.desc: Choose which metering modes lock exposure when One-Shot AF locks focus.

set-shutter-speed-range.desc: Limit the shutter speeds the camera can use.

set-aperture-range.desc: Limit the apertures the camera can use.

add-cropping-information.desc: Adds crop/aspect lines (6:6, 4:5 etc.) to the display and records them for later cropping.

default-erase-option.desc: Which option is pre-selected when you press Erase.

release-shutter-w-o-lens.desc: Allows shooting with no lens attached (pinholes, freelensing, some adapters).

retract-lens-on-power-off.desc: Retracts STM/retractable lenses when the camera turns off.

add-iptc-information.desc: Embeds IPTC metadata (registered via EOS Utility) in images.

add-my-menu-tab.desc: Create your own My Menu tab and fill it with your most-used items.

delete-all-items.desc: Deletes all items from My Menu tabs.

menu-display.desc: Open the menu on My Menu first, or show only My Menu.
